statement: Kernel-checked unconditional Paper E Theorem 4.1; advisory statement coverage pending. For natural a,b,M>0 with 2^(a+b)<3^a, infinitely many distinct odd Juggler starts n above every prescribed bound have actual itinerary O^a E^b, stay at least n during the prefix, end strictly above n, and have both endpoints congruent to 1 modulo 2M. The periodic-word code denominator is exactly (3^a-2^(a+b))/gcd(3^a-2^a,2^b-1), and these denominators are unbounded at fixed b>0. The simultaneous ReturnBox is proved recurrent for all natural a,b and M>0: exponents 3^a/2^(j+1) are distinct positive nonintegers, and the exact scalings and box bounds are verified, including M=1. The theorem applies the existing floor construction to this proved recurrence; no BoxRecurrence, exponential-sum, or equidistribution hypothesis remains. No actual cycle, common start at all precisions, integer-code realization, or termination theorem follows.
